home.title: Dashboard
home.intro: Manage your screens, your sites and their schedules.

screens.title: Screens
screens.empty: No screens yet. Add your first screen, then pair it with the device.
screens.intro: The screens of your sites. Pair a new screen with the code shown on the TV.
screens.revoked: The device of screen {name} is revoked. It can no longer play content.

create.name: Screen name

create.no_site: No site available: create a site first.

errors.device_not_found: No device is paired with this screen.
errors.pairing_code_expired: This code has expired. Restart pairing on the screen to get a new one.
errors.pairing_code_invalid: Unknown code. Check the code shown on the screen.
errors.pairing_code_unavailable: Pairing is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.

agents.command_args_invalid: The command parameters are not valid.
agents.command_screen_required: Choose a screen for this command.
agents.screen_not_in_site: This screen does not belong to this site.

power.calendar_exists: A calendar already uses this key.
power.plan_in_use: This plan is attached to a site, group or screen and cannot be deleted.

registry.module_not_found: This module does not exist or has no settings.

config.key_from_env: This value is set by the server environment.
config.scope_not_allowed: This setting cannot be changed at this level.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in to manage your screens.
login.already_initialized: The first administrator already exists. Sign in.
login.first_start: First start? Create the administrator account

bootstrap.title: First start
bootstrap.intro: Create the administrator account. The bootstrap token is in the server configuration or logs.

change_password.title: Change password
change_password.intro: Your password must be changed before you continue.

errors.pattern: This value has an invalid format.

pairing.title: Pair a screen
pairing.intro: Enter the code shown on the screen, then choose the matching screen.

code.label: Code shown on the screen
code.help: 6 characters. Upper and lower case are accepted. The code expires after 15 minutes.

pairing.done: Pairing confirmed for screen {name}. The device starts in a few seconds.

media.title: Media library
media.intro: Images, videos and PDF documents you can use in your playlists.

upload.title: Add files
upload.drop: Drop your files here or pick them from your device.

media.empty: No media yet. Upload your first file.

in_use.detail: {count, plural, =0 {{title} is still in use.} one {{title} is used in this playlist. Remove it before deleting:} other {{title} is used in these playlists. Remove it before deleting:}}

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.intro: A playlist is a sequence of items played in order, on a loop.
playlists.name: Playlist name
playlists.items: {count, plural, =0 {No items} one {# item} other {# items}}

playlist.title: Playlist
playlist.empty: This playlist is empty. Add a first item.

item.duration_help: Leave empty for the usual duration of the content.

schedules.title: Schedule
schedules.intro: Choose which playlist plays, on which target and at what times.
schedules.name: Name

target.label: Target
target.touches: {count, plural, =0 {No screens affected} one {# screen affected} other {# screens affected}}

rules.title: Weekly time slots
rules.all_day: With no time slot, the playlist plays all day, every day.
rules.help: The playlist plays during these slots, in site time.

problem.range: The end time must be after the start time.

priority.label: Priority
priority.help: When several schedules overlap on a target, the highest priority wins.

schedules.empty: No schedule yet. Screens stay black until a playlist is scheduled.

provenance.inherited: {level, select, organization {Inherited from the organization} site {Inherited from site {name}} group {Inherited from group {name}} screen {Inherited from screen {name}} other {Inherited}}

sites.title: Sites
sites.intro: Each site can have an agent that relays power commands to its screens.
sites.name: Name
sites.screens_count: {count, plural, =0 {no screens} one {# screen} other {# screens}}

agents.title: Site agent
agents.intro: The agent runs on the site's network. It connects to the server with a secret token.
agents.empty: No agent. Create one to control the power of this site's screens.
agents.one_active: Only one active agent per site. Revoke the current agent to create another.

token.title: Token for agent {name}
token.once: Copy this token now and enter it in the agent configuration. It will never be shown again. The previous token stops working immediately.

power.title: Power schedule
power.intro: Choose when screens are on. Outside the ranges, they are off.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: A plan is a typical week: screens are on during its time slots.
plans.name: Name
plans.rules_empty: With no range, the screen stays off.
plans.rules_help: The screen is on during these ranges, site time.
plans.empty: No plans. Create one to schedule power-on times.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.intro: Public holidays, closures, special openings: an exception takes precedence over the plan.
exceptions.label: Label
exceptions.window_help: Without times, the exception covers the whole day.

problem.required: Fill in the label, target and dates.
problem.period: The end date must be after the start date.
problem.window: Fill in both the start and end time, or neither.
problem.range: The end time must be after the start time.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.intro: Lists of days (public holidays, vacations) applied to plans.
calendars.key_help: Lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens.
calendars.days_count: {count, plural, =0 {no days} one {# day} other {# days}}

attachment.title: Attachment
attachment.intro: Attach a plan and calendars to the organization, a site, a group or a screen. Each level inherits from the level above.

supervision.title: Monitoring
supervision.intro: Fleet status, open incidents and remote commands.
supervision.agent_offline: The site agent is offline: commands are unavailable.
supervision.no_agent: This site has no active agent: commands are unavailable.

park.title: Screen status
park.intro: A screen switched off by the schedule is never an alert.

command.pending: Command sent, waiting for the agent's answer…

reasons.expired: the agent did not answer in time

detect.title: Detection for {name}
detect.none: No control method detected. Check that the screen is on and on the same network.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.intro: Choose who is emailed when a screen or an agent stops responding.

groups.title: Groups
groups.intro: Group a site's screens to give them the same settings.
groups.empty: No group for this site yet.
